description_en: Associates a specified data source with a specified parser
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定解析器关联指定数据源
name: AttachParserDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The parser ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429046.html operation to query the list of parsers and obtain the ParserId
parameters.help_zh: 解析器ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429046.html，查询解析器列表，获取**ParserId**
parameters.name: parser_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html operation to query the list of data sources and obtain the DataSourceId
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html，查询数据源列表，获取**DataSourceId**
parameters.name: data_source_id
